agent_explanation: High-speed (vx~-40.9, ~0.64 units/step) large-radius (r~1.19) body strikes a minimum-thickness (0.1) vertical wall. Despite ~22 substeps per step (~0.03 travel per substep), contact/positional correction fails to stop the body: it goes from clear (+0.27 at step 9) to deeply embedded (-0.39 at step 10, overlap 0.388 > 0.15 limit). Likely impulse plus positional correction is insufficient for thin-wall, high-momentum impact, allowing deep penetration in one step. Slowing vx to -10 removes the failure.
